thread:
maria (Finance): Heads up team — rolling out a small set of billing changes today at 18:00 PT. TL;DR: 1) Introduce a "Startup Buffer" (one-time 25k-token buffer for eligible startups) 2) Formal partner-exception process for pilots 3) Self-serve overage cap of $500/mo to limit surprises 4) New paid rate-limit tiers on Hosted API (defaults unchanged). Full doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/changes-2026-03-23 :tada:

billing-bot: Published new doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/changes-2026-03-23 (ops) 

jamie (Product): Quick Q — is the Startup Buffer auto-applied for small orgs or do they need to apply? :eyes:

maria (Finance): Startup Buffer auto-applies for orgs created within the last 6 months with active trial and < $5k historical spend. Others can apply via Support -> Billing -> "Startup Buffer" (manual review 24–48h).

kevin (Eng): Technical: are we changing per-key RPS headers/defaults? Will Dedicated/private customers be impacted?

maria (Finance): Hosted defaults remain the same for existing keys. New paid tiers will be offered: 250 rps and 1000 rps for purchased tiers. Dedicated/Private unaffected — customers can set their own rate limits in the console. We'll push SDK notes this evening.

alina (Growth): How does the $500 overage cap interact with annual contracts? Can AMs waive it for >enterprise deals?

maria (Finance): Annual/enterprise deals are handled by AMs — we batch overage invoicing monthly and can issue waivers case-by-case. The $500 cap is for self-serve only to reduce surprise bills.

dave_ops: Do we need to update alerting/ops playbooks for the new tiers? Recommend we tag 429s with the tier when possible. :rotating_light:

kevin (Eng): I'll open a tiny runtime PR to emit `x-rw-rate-tier` and ensure 429 logs include tier id. Example check for devs:
```
curl -I https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
# look for headers: x-rw-ratelimit, x-rw-rate-tier
```

maria (Finance): Thanks — please CC @billing-alerts and @ops on the PR. Rollout window 18:00 PT, expected <30m to flip defaults for new purchases. No key rotations expected.

alina (Growth): Copy — I'll draft the customer banner and a short FAQ for the docs page.

billing-bot: Announcement scheduled in #general at 18:05 PT.

maria (Finance): One more note: partner pilots that need temporary higher allowances should DM me or ping @finance-team. We'll maintain a whitelist for the next 90 days and review usage weekly.
